observations.behavior: Adds a guard to skip the regex scan if the team has no SignalReports, and refactors the report lookup to use separate indexed lookups instead of a single OR over joins.
observations.code_quote: # The array form, as in `implementation_pr_report_filter`, so Postgres probes the artefact index.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces database query cost and improves performance for the implementation PR webhook by avoiding unnecessary joins and filtering out teams without reports.

observations.behavior: Adds a new static method `report_ids_for_task_ids` and refactors `reports_for_task_ids_filter` to return a list of querysets instead of a single Q object, enabling separate indexed lookups.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows callers to run report lookups as separate indexed queries rather than a single OR over joins, potentially improving performance and maintainability.

observations.behavior: Changes the return type of `reports_for_task_ids_filter` from a Q object to a list of querysets, and removes the team_id filter from the returned querysets.
